name: Pull-down kitchen faucet
notes: Rig: spout swivel Y -90...90; lever hinge X 0...60 (side lever); head slide down 0...0.2 (child of spout). Option: stream (water.stream) linked to the lever (on from 10 degrees). States: off, on, swung-left, pulled-out.
summary: Pull-down kitchen faucet: high-arc gooseneck spout, spray head, side lever, deck plate; lever opens a water stream.
